name: Bahia Pez Vela Resort
description: A relaxed beachfront resort near Playa Ocotal with 40 individually owned three- and four-bedroom villas featuring full kitchens, living areas, and washer/dryers. Two infinity pools, an on-site restaurant, and access to a private black-sand beach make it a comfortable base for families and groups.
hero_description: Easygoing beachfront villas with infinity pools and a private black-sand beach near Playa Ocotal.
local_insight: Best for families and groups of friends who want spacious self-catering villas and a quiet, low-key setting rather than nightlife. Couples and solo travelers will find better value elsewhere, and you'll want a rental car since little is within walking distance.

faq.q: How far is Bahia Pez Vela Resort from the airport?
faq.a: The resort is about a 40-minute drive from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

faq.q: Does the resort have beach access?
faq.a: Yes, the resort sits on its own private black-sand beach and is a 20-minute walk from Playa Ocotal, which offers excellent snorkeling.

faq.q: What should I know before booking?
faq.a: Villas are individually owned so decor varies from unit to unit, and the beach is small and rocky in places. There's also little nightlife nearby, so a rental car is recommended.

amenities: Two infinity pools with ocean views

room_types.name: Three-Bedroom Villa
room_types.description: Individually owned and decorated multi-level villa with a full kitchen, living and dining areas, washer/dryer, and furnished balconies.

room_types.name: Four-Bedroom Villa
room_types.description: Larger individually owned villa with up to two-and-a-half bathrooms, spacious dining and sitting areas, and, in some units, a private outdoor pool.

traveler_profile_reasons.reason: Large three- and four-bedroom villas with full kitchens, laundry, and separate living areas suit families needing space and self-catering flexibility.
Big villas with six- to eight-person dining tables and multiple bedrooms make it easy for friends to share and cook together.
The secluded location with virtually no nightlife and a low-key vibe is ideal for those focused on relaxing rather than partying.
